Execute a Multi-Facet Structured LLM Coding Design

Source: R/coding.R
code_texts.Rd

Orchestrates crossed LLM scoring across units x prompts x models x temperatures x replicates with content-addressed caching, strict JSON schema validation, retry handling on malformed/invalid outputs, resumable atomic checkpointing (checkpoint_file), partial-failure recovery (on_error), and pluggable backends.

Usage

code_texts(
  data,
  text_col,
  id_col = NULL,
  design,
  backend,
  cache = coding_cache("memory"),
  max_validation_retries = 2L,
  coerce = FALSE,
  keep_cols = TRUE,
  keep_raw = FALSE,
  checkpoint_file = NULL,
  checkpoint_every = 25L,
  on_error = c("warn_na", "stop")
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame containing the texts to score and any optional unit-level metadata (e.g., human_score, group, wave, cluster, or downstream covariates).

text_col

Name of the character column containing input texts.

id_col

Optional name of the unique unit identifier column. If NULL, sequential IDs "unit_1", "unit_2", ... are created.

design

An coding_design() object.

backend

Either a single llm_backend object (e.g., backend_mock(), backend_openai(), backend_ollama()) or a named list of llm_backend objects keyed by model name (with optional ".default" fallback).

cache

An coding_cache() object. Defaults to an in-memory cache.

max_validation_retries

Maximum retries when backend output fails JSON parsing or schema validation. Default 2L.

coerce

Logical passed to validate_coded_output(). Default FALSE.

keep_cols

Logical or character vector specifying which additional columns from data to attach to each coded row. TRUE (default) preserves all non-text columns that do not collide with facet or schema names; FALSE keeps none; a character vector preserves only those columns.

keep_raw

Logical; if TRUE, retains raw JSON text in a raw_output column. Default FALSE.

checkpoint_file

Optional path to an .rds checkpoint file for resumable batch coding. Completed valid cells are persisted atomically every checkpoint_every new cells and immediately upon failure or completion; re-running with the same checkpoint_file automatically resumes without re-scoring completed cells.

checkpoint_every

Positive integer specifying how often (in newly completed cells) to flush checkpoint_file. Default 25L.

on_error

Failure handling policy after all retries for a cell are exhausted: "warn_na" (default: records NA for failed cells, populates $failures and $failed_indices, and emits a concise summary warning) or "stop" (flushes checkpoint_file first so completed cells are never lost, then aborts with an actionable error).

Value

An S3 object of class "llm_coded_data" with components:

  • scores: a tibble::tibble() with one row per (unit, prompt, model, temperature, replicate) cell, validated schema columns, cache_hit, attempts, valid, and preserved unit metadata.

  • design: the input coding_design().

  • schema: the active coding_schema().

  • cache_stats: snapshot of cache_stats() after execution.

  • failures: tibble of cells that failed validation after all retries.

  • failed_indices: integer vector of input row indices with at least one failed cell.

  • failed_units: character vector of unit IDs with at least one failed cell.

  • resumed_count: integer count of cells restored from checkpoint_file.

  • checkpoint_file: checkpoint path (or NULL).

Examples

texts <- tibble::tibble(
  id = paste0("u", 1:8),
  text = paste("Sample diary entry", 1:8),
  true_score = seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 8)
)
des <- coding_design(
  prompts = c(p1 = "Rate: {text}", p2 = "Score: {text}"),
  models = c("m1", "m2"),
  schema = coding_schema(score = schema_field("numeric"))
)
coded <- code_texts(texts, text_col = "text", id_col = "id", design = des, backend = backend_mock())
coded
